RagShortTexts: A prince's druzhina rests on service, revenue and maintenance under unequal ranks.
Protection, reward and opportunity sustain loyalty; departing followers weaken princely action.

Variants.Content: Rus retainers gather through relationships, income and maintenance; prominent boyars add networks and men of their own. Gifts, counsel and protection encourage continued service, while unpaid claims, rivalry or defeat may prompt departure. A prince maintains experienced followers through continuing allocations among upkeep, campaign gains and household needs.

Followers prepare mounts, gear and food, with uncertain payment troubling households. A low-ranking man bears injury or a lost horse differently from a landed boyar. Fighters judge a leader's care for losses and ability to support families, sustaining loyalty through repeated practical dealings.
